name: SAUNABOX Pulse PRO: Infrared Sauna with Red-light Therapy
description: SaunaBox® Pulse PRO — Infrared Sauna + Red Light Experience the next generation of at-home wellness with Pulse PRO, a portable infrared sauna designed to help you relax, unwind, and feel your best — right from home. Pulse PRO uses advanced ThermoCell infrared heating panels to create a warm, soothing environment that helps you break a deep sweat and enjoy a restorative session anytime you want. Built directly into the tent, the integrated 660nm-850nm red light adds an additional layer of wellness support, creating a calm and rejuvenating atmosphere during your session. The compact, foldable design fits easily in apartments, home gyms, or small spaces. Made with OEKO-TEX® certified materials and MylarMax insulation for comfortable, consistent heat. OEKO-TEX® Certified & PFAS-Free Built with an OEKO-TEX® Certified insulated cover, meaning it's been tested and verified to be free from harmful substances. Our sauna fabric is also independently tested and certified PFAS-Free from harmful “forever chemicals,” ensuring a cleaner, safer wellness experience. What’s Included: • Portable infrared sauna tent • 6x ThermoCell infrared panels • Bluetooth controller • Integrated 660nm-850nm red light panel • Foldable wood stool • SweatLock floor mat • Carrying case + cords Product Details: • Ultra-low EMF infrared heating • Bluetooth remote control system • OEKO-TEX® certified fabrics • MylarMax heat-reflective lining • ~160°F max internal heat (varies by environment) • Quick, easy 15-minute assembly • Compact 36" x 36" footprint Specifications Voltage: 110V Wattage: 1600W / 50–60Hz Ultra-Low EMF Medical-Grade 660nm-850nm Red Light (320 LEDs) ThermoCell Far Infrared Panels Oeko-Tex ® Certified Fabrics
